source: the variations worked example: the original and its one variation, "The sneakers"
note: Three slots, one per person. Malik and Tasha are in both versions. Malik's friend is "his best friend" with the chips in the original and Dre in version 1: the same relationship, the same chips, the same part (he watches the bet, then sees the win), so he's one slot under the name a script gives him, Dre, in both versions. Nobody else is a slot: the montage in each version shows only Malik, and the crowds at the game and the show and the fans in line are background, never a character. Names come from the cast and the scripts; the looks start from what they say (he's 17; she's his aunt) and fill in the rest.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
Never say: guaranteed profit; can't lose
End line (the default call to action every video ends on; it may be adapted to the story if it still names the brand and where to find it): Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image: logo, colours and layout exact, numbers free; a logo-only screen comes as the logo alone, and the screen is invented around it:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:5 "Home (rich)" (mobile, home, portfolio) — required at: win
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up), logo-only: the logo is attached, the screen invented — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down), logo-only: the logo is attached, the screen invented — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading), logo-only: the logo is attached, the screen invented — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>

<brief>They said I'd fail: Malik bets his savings on fomo after his aunt calls it a waste.</brief>
<cast>
char:1 Malik, 17, the hero
char:2 Aunt Tasha
</cast>

5| TASHA: A phone app? That's your college money!

7| TASHA: Thirty days. Then you're bagging groceries.
8| Malik's best friend watches from the back door, eating chips.
9| SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT

12| MALIK: Come on. One more.

14| Wordless montage, Malik in every shot, getting rich: Malik ripping open a delivery box of studio gear, Malik behind the mixing desk of his own studio, Malik courtside at a packed game, Malik front row at a sold-out arena show as confetti falls.
15| SCENE 3 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
16| Malik slides his phone across the counter to Tasha.
17| ★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — the portfolio balance, as it stops in front of Tasha
18| TASHA: That's… real?
19| In the doorway, his best friend drops the chips.
20| MALIK: Still want me bagging groceries?
21| MALIK: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
</version>
<version slot="1">
1| SCENE 1 — INT. HALLWAY — DAY
2| Aunt Tasha holds up an empty sneaker box, the lid hanging off.
3| TASHA: You SOLD your Jordans?! Those were four hundred dollars!
4| MALIK: Every cent went into fomo.
5| TASHA: Shoes you can wear. You can't wear an app!
6| MALIK: Four weeks. Then we talk.
7| TASHA: Four weeks. Or you wear my old slippers.
8| Malik's friend Dre leans in the doorway behind him, eating chips.
9| DRE: Bro sold the Jordans.
10| SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
11| ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Malik's phone
12| Malik sits on the floor beside the empty sneaker box, lit blue by his phone.
13| MALIK: Okay. Once more.
14| ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Malik's phone in his hand, a phone ding
15| Wordless montage, Malik in every shot, the grind first: another late night on the floor, a red day he shakes off, a small first win; then getting rich: a tower of sneaker boxes toppling into Malik's arms, Malik signing sneakers for a line of fans outside a store, Malik striding into his own glass sneaker vault.
16| SCENE 3 — INT. HALLWAY — DAY, FOUR WEEKS LATER

18| ★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — the portfolio balance, on the phone on the lid

22| MALIK: And those are your new slippers.
